title: Add new release repositories
author: knorth55
body:
<!--
  Which release team will maintain these repositories?
  If you do not yet have a release team in the ros2-gbp-github-org project, please use the [new release team](https://github.com/ros2-gbp/ros2-gbp-github-org/issues/new?assignees=&labels=&projects=&template=new_release_team.md&title=Add+release+team) template instead.
  That template supports adding a new team and repositories at the same time.
-->
* Name of the release team: audio_common

<!--
Before release repositories are created, repositories and packages should be submitted to the official rosdistro repository https://github.com/ros/rosdistro for naming review.
Guidelines for package naming are describe in REP-144: https://www.ros.org/reps/rep-0144.html

If you are requesting multiple repositories at once, please list them all here instead of creating multiple issues.
-->
* Release repositories to add:
  * [audio_capture](https://github.com/ros-drivers/audio_common/tree/ros2/audio_capture)
  * [audio_common](https://github.com/ros-drivers/audio_common/tree/ros2/audio_common)
  * [audio_common_msgs](https://github.com/ros-drivers/audio_common/tree/ros2/audio_common_msgs)
  * [audio_play](https://github.com/ros-drivers/audio_common/tree/ros2/audio_play)
  * [sound_play](https://github.com/ros-drivers/audio_common/tree/ros2/sound_play)
  * [sound_play_msgs](https://github.com/ros-drivers/audio_common/tree/ros2/sound_play_msgs)

* ROSDISTRO: https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/50756



related to https://github.com/ros2-gbp/ros2-gbp-github-org/issues/1041
